decisive_items: heterogeneously enhancing expansile mass in the upper pole of the right kidney
tumoral extension into the right renal vein and inferior vena cava
response.rationale: R1 matches the classic presentation of renal cell carcinoma: large enhancing renal mass with vascular invasion and pulmonary metastases. R3 is less likely due to atypical enhancement for angiomyolipoma and lack of macroscopic fat. R2 is implausible given adult age.

rejected.why: Enhancement pattern and vascular invasion are atypical for angiomyolipoma; no fat attenuation described.
Nephroblastoma is predominantly a pediatric tumor; patient is 27 years old.
